description: A use carrying the proof bound at open, charged at the challenged price: the operator signs and persists the voucher for cumulative 125. The baseline the use rejects pair with. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: After authenticating the request, the operator meters the delivered service and signs the corresponding cumulative voucher.

description: A use whose proof is well formed for this channel and challenge but signed by a stranger, not the payer whose proof was bound at open: it must not authenticate the request. Pair: session-use-verify-accept. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: | authentication | object | REQUIRED | Reusable proof bound at open, as defined in {{session-bearer-proof}} |

description: A client-signed server and channel receive a use: only a client voucher authenticates a client-signed request. Pair: session-use-verify-accept. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: This action is valid only when voucherSigner is operator.

description: A use whose cost the server metered after serving at 7, below the challenged price: the operator signs and persists the voucher for cumulative 107, not 125. The baseline the metered rejects pair with. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: When cost is known only after generation begins, an operator-mode server MUST reserve sufficient channel capacity before delivery and persist the operator-signed voucher before releasing the response bytes whose cost it authorizes.

description: A metered cost of 900 takes the voucher to cumulative 1000, exactly the deposit. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-over-deposit-reject. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: When cost is known only after generation begins, an operator-mode server MUST reserve sufficient channel capacity before delivery and persist the operator-signed voucher before releasing the response bytes whose cost it authorizes.

description: A metered cost of 901 would take the voucher to cumulative 1001, past the deposit of 1000: nothing is charged. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-full-deposit-accept. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: When cost is known only after generation begins, an operator-mode server MUST reserve sufficient channel capacity before delivery and persist the operator-signed voucher before releasing the response bytes whose cost it authorizes.

description: A metered cost of 0 (nothing was delivered): the voucher must not advance. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-accept. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: Amounts already covered by a persisted voucher and released response bytes remain committed; unused reserved capacity MUST NOT advance the voucher.

description: A metered use whose proof is signed by a stranger: a metered charge still needs the request authenticated first. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-accept. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: Authenticate client mode with a valid voucher, or operator mode with a valid use proof.

description: A metered use whose proof names the bound challenge and the real payer but carries a stranger's signature: a server that checks the payer without verifying the signature would charge it. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-accept. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: | authentication | object | REQUIRED | Reusable proof bound at open, as defined in {{session-bearer-proof}} |

description: A metered use on a channel whose forced close began (closureStartedAt set): the bound proof no longer authenticates and nothing is charged. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-accept. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: Servers MUST reject it once close begins or the channel becomes terminal.

description: A metered use on a sealed channel: the bound proof no longer authenticates and nothing is charged. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-accept. The server's operator-signed channel holds a deposit of 1000 with 100 accepted and spent, and binds the payer's proof; the challenged amount is 25.

spec.quote: Servers MUST reject it once close begins or the channel becomes terminal.

description: A retry of a metered use the server already charged a total of 7 (a lost response): the channel holds 107 accepted and spent, with the request recorded under its challenge and Idempotency-Key. The server answers with the recorded voucher for 107 and charges nothing; a server that charges again persists 114. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-replay-advance-accept.

spec.quote: Replaying an already processed request MAY return the cached receipt and MUST NOT change channel state or deliver additional service.

description: A stale retry of an earlier step of a request already charged a total of 7: it asks for 5, below the recorded total, so it is answered with the recorded voucher for 107 and charges nothing. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-replay-advance-accept.

spec.quote: Replaying an already processed request MAY return the cached receipt and MUST NOT change channel state or deliver additional service.

description: The request already charged a total of 7 is metered on to a total of 8, as a stream charges as it is served: only the difference of 1 is charged, so the voucher is for 108, not 115. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-replay-accept.

spec.quote: When cost is known only after generation begins, an operator-mode server MUST reserve sufficient channel capacity before delivery and persist the operator-signed voucher before releasing the response bytes whose cost it authorizes.

description: The Idempotency-Key was recorded for a request under another challenge: it is not this request, so it is neither replayed nor charged. Pair: session-use-verify-metered-replay-accept.

spec.quote: Servers SHOULD cache (challengeId, idempotencyKey) pairs and MUST NOT increment spentAmount twice for a duplicate idempotent request.
